**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** All 34 calls now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Every file under `packages` passes `node --check`.

I left two calls in `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` alone. It is vendored third party code. Say the word and I will change it too.

`cache.query` is a separate API and was not touched.
